title: Diplomacy: ready both planets at once
description: Diplomacy readies up to two exhausted planets, in the primary and in the secondary. The engine asks "ready which planet" once per planet, so the screen asked twice in a row (pick, Confirm, pick, Confirm). Now the exhausted planets are shown together on one compact bar and on the map: tap up to two (list or map), each shows its resource and influence value and a green ring with a check once picked, then one Confirm sends both answers as a single ready_planets batch. The engine's questions are unchanged: it forces the readying (there is no decline), so Confirm needs two planets, or one when only one is exhausted; with exactly as many exhausted planets as owed they start picked. The bar folds down to the summary and Confirm (Hide) so a phone keeps the map; prepared secondaries (Review/Auto) store the pair and open the bar with both planets already picked. The before shots are taken on the base commit consolidated-final-2026-10-09 (npm scripts cannot render two trees at once, so they are copied to before/); the after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- BO. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server, not captured engine states.

shots.heading: Before: primary or secondary, desktop
shots.caption: The question opens as a single-planet bar ("Rule 34.2  Ready which planet"): tap a highlighted planet or a chip, Confirm, and the bar opens again for the second planet.

shots.heading: After: every exhausted planet at once
shots.caption: One bar names Diplomacy and the job (Ready 2 planets, 0 of 2 picked). Each exhausted planet is a chip with its resource and influence value (Jord 2/2, Wellon 1/2, Tar'Mann 1/1); the same planets are ringed on the map. Confirm stays off until both are picked.

shots.heading: Before: phone (390 x 844)
shots.caption: The old bar on a phone, one planet per question.

shots.heading: After: phone (390 x 844)
shots.caption: The new bar sits above the bottom buttons, chips are 44 px tall and wrap onto two rows; the map above stays visible and tappable.

shots.heading: Before: a tap on the map
shots.caption: A tap on Wellon selects only Wellon; Confirm readies it, then the question comes back.

shots.heading: After: planets picked on the map
shots.caption: Taps on Wellon and Jord on the map: both planets get a green ring and a check, the list chips show the same state, the count reads 2 of 2 picked and Confirm is on. Tapping a third planet swaps out the oldest pick.

shots.heading: Before: one planet picked in the list
shots.caption: The chip list picks a single planet, then Confirm.

shots.heading: After: one of two picked
shots.caption: One chip picked: 1 of 2 picked, the hint says to tap one more planet, Confirm is disabled.

shots.heading: After: both picked
shots.caption: Second chip picked (Tar'Mann): 2 of 2, Confirm enabled. Clear starts over.

shots.heading: Before: phone, one planet picked
shots.caption: One planet at a time on the phone.

shots.heading: After: phone, both picked
shots.caption: Both planets picked on a phone (tapped, not clicked); Confirm and Clear are 44 px buttons.

shots.heading: After: phone, folded with Hide
shots.caption: Hide folds the bar to the summary and Confirm (the dialog's minimise). The picks are kept, the map is free, and Confirm is still inside the screen at least 44 px tall.

shots.heading: Before: another seat watching
shots.caption: Everyone else sees a slim bar naming who decides.

shots.heading: After: another seat watching
shots.caption: Unchanged for spectators and other seats: the same read-only waiting bar; only the deciding seat gets the new bar.

shots.heading: Before: preparing the secondary
shots.caption: Preparing Diplomacy while another seat resolves the card: the first planet, then a second question for the second planet.

shots.heading: After: preparing the secondary
shots.caption: The same ready bar in preparation mode: Jord and Tar'Mann picked together; Confirm saves the pair in the plan and sends nothing.

shots.heading: Before: the prepared plan at arrival
shots.caption: The prepared answer is one planet at a time (Prepared: Ready Jord).

shots.heading: After: the prepared pair at arrival
shots.caption: The prepared bar reads Ready Jord and Tar'Mann, and the real ready bar opens with both picked; Confirm (either one) sends one ready_planets batch. In Auto mode the pair is sent by itself after the usual short hold.

notes.title: Wire format.
notes.text: POST batch with plan {"kind":"ready_planets","steps":[{"kind":"ready_planet","planet":"jord"},{"kind":"ready_planet","planet":"tarmann"}]}: one step per engine question, in the order picked.

notes.title: Server.
notes.text: BatchKind::ReadyPlanets replays the engine's own questions and matches each step against the options it really offers; a planet that is no longer exhausted, an ambiguous step or a different question refuses the plan with the usual 409 and changes nothing. At most 2 distinct planets.

notes.title: Engine rules unchanged.
notes.text: The engine forces the readying (two planets, or what is left); there is no decline, so zero is never offered unless nothing is exhausted, when no question opens at all.
